title: Start from a template
description: Open a ready-made project, look around and see how to adapt it.
outcomes: Open a template and see what it contains
recap: Templates are full projects you can adapt.
Every component stays editable, with a live preview.
Checks and Architecture show the whole picture before you export.

steps.intro: Templates are complete projects you can open and adapt. Let's open one.
steps.open: Each card shows which stages a template covers. Let's take the first one.
steps.project: Everything the template added is listed here, grouped by stage.
steps.edit: Open any component to change it.
steps.preview: The form holds its settings, and the preview shows the files it writes.
steps.checks: Checks confirms the template is consistent before you change anything.
steps.diagram: Architecture shows how the parts connect: servers, groups, plays and services.
steps.export: Export takes the whole project home: plain files, a preset, or a CLI command.
steps.done: Now open a template for real, or build your own from scratch.
